notes: 88-key flagship synthesizer/music workstation (GEX wooden keyboard action); no "Synthesizer" or "Keyboard" category/type exists in the allowed enums, so category=audio/type=Other was chosen as closest fit — it also functions as a class-compliant USB audio/MIDI interface over USB TO HOST (6 in / 32 out ch @44.1kHz, or 6 in / 8 out @44.1-192kHz). Desktop instrument, not rack-mountable (omit rackUnits). No USB version (2.0/3.0) or MIDI-DIN pin count is stated in Yamaha's spec table, so no USB grade is set; MIDI IN/OUT/THRU assumed standard 5-pin DIN (industry-universal, not stated explicitly). Power inlet is described in Yamaha's manual as an "AC IN" terminal accepting the supplied AC power cord; third-party retailer (Kraft Music) accessory listing specifies an IEC C13 cord, confirming an IEC (C14) inlet — mapped to connector "iec". All audio I/O (main OUTPUT, ASSIGNABLE OUTPUT, A/D INPUT, PHONES, foot controller/switch jacks) are 6.3mm (1/4") TRS jacks per Yamaha; OUTPUT and ASSIGNABLE OUTPUT are specified as balanced. Connector counts/names cross-checked against a second web summary of the same spec sheet and against YamahaSynth.com's Montage M connection guide (confirms USB TO HOST uses a "type A to type B" cable, i.e. USB-B on the instrument). Specs are identical across M6/M7/M8x except keyboard size/weight/dimensions.
